description: This file contains utility functions for generating curl commands and fetch calls based on network request entries, including platform-specific escaping and handling of request data and headers.

methods.name: generateCurlCommand
methods.description: Generates a curl command string from a network request entry, with platform-specific escaping and header handling.

methods.name: generateFetchCall
methods.description: Creates a fetch API call string from a network request entry, supporting different styles (browser or Node.js).
